title: penstemon crandallii subsp. procumbens
intro: Penstemon crandallii subsp. procumbens, commonly known as Crandall's beardtongue, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Crandall's beardtongue include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
